tests.name: lifecycle_forget_excludes_from_default_reads
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — forget tombstones memory to Forgotten state and excludes it from active reads

tests.name: lifecycle_restore_within_window_same_id
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — restore within 30-day window succeeds, returns same UUID with state=active, clears restore_until

tests.name: lifecycle_restore_after_window_rejected
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — restore after window expires is rejected without mutation

tests.name: lifecycle_expired_valid_until_excluded_from_current_reads
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01, V-TRUTH-01 — records past valid_until excluded from current-time queries

tests.name: lifecycle_immediate_delete_cascades_to_dependents
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — hard_delete marks primary Deleted and cascades dependent link-table rows; dependent memory record itself is preserved

tests.name: lifecycle_source_cascade_deletes_only_source_records
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — source prefix cascade affects only records from that source; other sources untouched

tests.name: lifecycle_session_cascade_removes_session_records
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — session cascade removes only records from that session; other sessions untouched

tests.name: lifecycle_namespace_cascade_isolates_records
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — namespace isolation: deleting records in one namespace does not affect records in other namespaces

tests.name: lifecycle_tool_mcp_openclaw_source_cascades
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01, V-TOOL-01 — tool:, mcp:, openclaw: source prefix cascades each affect only their respective records; user-sourced records unaffected

tests.name: lifecycle_subject_cascade_deletes_subject_records_and_marks_key
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01, V-CRYPTO-01 — subject cascade deletes all subject-bound memories and marks shred-key status 'destroyed'; other subjects untouched

tests.name: lifecycle_source_cascade_does_not_remove_independent_evidence
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — source cascade must NOT remove evidence rows from independent sources; independent corroboration is preserved after the primary is deleted

tests.name: lifecycle_preview_blast_radius_shows_dependents_and_evidence
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — preview_hard_delete computes correct blast radius with dependents, marks IRREVERSIBLE, encodes base_revision in token

tests.name: lifecycle_forget_is_idempotent
tests.validates: V-LIFE-01 — forget is idempotent: repeated forget does not create duplicate audit/revision rows

invariantsVerified: Forget → truth_state = Forgotten, excluded from default reads
Restore within window → same UUID, truth_state = Active, restore_until cleared
Restore after window → rejected, state unchanged
Expiry (valid_until passed) → excluded from current-time reads
Immediate hard-delete → content Deleted, dependent link-table rows cascaded, independent record preserved
Source cascade (tool:, mcp:, openclaw:, user:) → only matching-source records affected
Session cascade → only matching-session records affected
Namespace isolation → cascade within one namespace does not affect other namespaces
Subject cascade → all subject-bound records deleted, shred-key marked destroyed, other subjects untouched
Independent evidence (evidence rows from different source_event_id) NOT removed by source cascade
Preview blast radius shows dependents + hard_delete marked IRREVERSIBLE with revision-bound token
Forget idempotency: duplicate forget does not advance revision or write duplicate rows
nonNegotiablesVerified: Source cascade does not affect independent evidence
